title: To the Lighthouse

vibeProfile.oneLine: A family, a seaside house, and ten years passing toward the lighthouse.

summary: Across two days separated by ten years and a war, the Ramsay family and their guests gather at a summer house by the sea, where a childhood promise of a trip to the lighthouse hangs unfulfilled. Woolf's most autobiographical and perhaps most perfect novel dissolves plot into the flow of consciousness and the passage of time itself, with a famous central section in which years and deaths pass in a few luminous pages. A profound meditation on time, loss and art.
whyReadIt: Woolf's most perfect novel, a meditation on time, family and loss by the sea. That middle section is a marvel.

funFacts.text: Its short middle section, 'Time Passes', compresses a decade and several deaths into a few pages.
